SYNTHETIC fixtures. Every .log here was written by hand from the host's documented message
formats (pokeldn-src: trade_runtime.ConsoleLog's "[%7.1fs] " stamp, transport.py, mg_server.py,
host_app.py, host_mg_app.py) and every answer block the tests use is built byte-for-byte from the
layouts in asm/sloop-svc.s and asm/call-chain.s. None of this is a hardware capture.
